title_zh: 网络剧：片场里的杀青时刻
title_en: Chinese TV Dramas (20/20): Web Series, Wrapping Up on Set
note_en: 从……到…… ("from ... to ...") can be repeated to sweep across a whole range: 从古装宫廷到都市职场，从悬疑破案到温暖家庭 "from palace costume dramas to urban workplace stories, from crime mysteries to warm family tales." Unlike English, the 从……到 phrases come before the subject and verb, as a frame for the rest of the sentence.

sentences.en: Anna thinks that no matter how short and fast shows become, like the micro-dramas made for vertical phone screens, maybe what has really changed the act of watching TV itself is the experience that bullet comments offer: complete strangers posting comments together in real time, watching and chatting at once. More memorable than quietly finishing a whole season alone are often those moments of watching and chatting with someone else, just as she and Xiao Min have been doing all these evenings.
